merge: quarantine conflicting scheme-free labels, deterministic dedup before split; never use predictions for curation
selection: tune only: maximum macro source recall at global threshold constrained to empirical FPR <=1% for every source with both classes; tie min-source-recall then AP. Report source-support caveats. Baseline frozen control is scored identically on tune.
development_improvement_gate: macro recall gain >=0.02 and no supported-source recall loss >0.05 vs frozen v6 tune control
calibration: selected candidate only, sigmoid C1000 max_iter200 on calibration partition, positive slope required
thresholds: selected candidate only, per-source empirical FPR warning1%, high0.1% on threshold partition, sources without benign reported as positive-only
evaluation: Freeze selected candidate and policies before scoring new_test and all observed vendor/PhishTank/LegitPhish benchmarks. No further selection on benchmark outcomes.
limits: No claim of new Indonesian labels or human reviewers.
No training on previously observed benchmark rows; they remain observed regressions.
Domain disjointness does not establish campaign or temporal independence.
More data can worsen the model; improvements must be evidenced on the same evaluation cohorts.
Use public URL-label files only; never download or execute page HTML or visit targets.
positive_only_or_small_sources: Report separately; never invent a source FPR, and sources with fewer than 100 benign cannot independently constrain threshold selection.
mapping_basis: CompPhish states 0 legitimate/1 phishing; Wangchuk and PhishBD mappings corroborated by exact release class counts matching publisher-described legitimate/phishing totals. No per-case labels changed.
